objective: Add a fail-closed, separately identified reconstruction path for the missing frozen v0.2 model artifact without replacing the original production artifact or relaxing scientific acceptance criteria.

root_causes: Code review identified that an output directory outside the project root could fail during provenance path serialization after training and artifact creation. The script now validates containment before training.
A failed or interrupted local write could leave partial outputs without an explicit reconstruction status. The script now writes an IN_PROGRESS record before artifact serialization.
The first CI run was a push event. The pull_request-specific cycle-record enforcement step was skipped because the event was not a pull_request event.

findings: A green push-triggered CI run does not prove that pull_request-only lifecycle enforcement passed.
Output containment must be validated before expensive training and before any output is created.
An incomplete reconstruction must remain visibly marked IN_PROGRESS and production_eligible=false.
A reconstruction run is not evidence of recovery of the original model binary.
